The '''Tetan Royal Palace''' was the royal palace located on [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. Jedi Master [[Hakkun Re Hanuther]] was an advisor to the palace. The structure massive residential facility at the heart of the [[Royal District/Legends|Royal District]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]]. Home to the ruling monarch of Empress Teta and the seat of government in Imperial times, the Palace was constructed over the foundations of the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]] according to legends.<ref name="NoP" />

The massive complex had nine interconnected spires that towered over the cityscape. The golden spires represented the nine worlds of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]]: [[Keres I]], [[Gillad]], [[Mozos]], [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], [[Tryast]], [[Phiris]], [[Phoros]], [[Ronika/Legends|Ronika]], and [[Keres II]]. Located along the equatorial axis, the rising [[Koros|sun]] would hit each spire in the same order that the planets [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the star. Connected by low walls, the grounds surrounding the spires was a sprawling garden complex with local and imported flora. Many cottages were located within the gardens to house favored nobles from each world. At the core of the Palace was a block of [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] which was believed to have been brought from the ruins of the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]]. Whatever the truth, the monument stood as a testament to a lost age of Empress Teta's history.<ref name="NoP" />
